sn4.21:1.4: The matted hair and antelope hide are well known symbols of the Brahmins. The “cluster fig tree” (_udumbara_) was used for ritual vessels, posts, and firewood, and was regarded as Prajāpatī’s tree, a special source of vitality (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 4.6.1.3).
sn4.21:1.8: Even though these mendicants were diligent, their wisdom was not developed enough for them to recognize Māra.
